module_summary: UART transmitter: one-hot 4-phase FSM (rest/start/data/stop) shifts a latched byte LSB-first, paced by a baud-tick sub-module.

anchors.name: phase_r
anchors.why: One-hot rest/start/data/stop state; selects line level and shift/count actions.

anchors.name: hold_reg
anchors.why: Shift register loaded with tx_data, shifted right each baud tick; LSB drives line.

anchors.name: nib
anchors.why: Bit counter of data bits sent; terminal count moves FSM to stop phase.

anchors.name: strobe
anchors.why: Baud tick from pacer; advances FSM phases and shifts the data register.

anchors.name: at_rest
anchors.why: Idle decode of FSM; parks the baud pacer and drives busy.

anchors.name: tx_valid
anchors.why: Input request; in rest phase loads byte and starts transmission.

anchors.name: tx_ready
anchors.why: Ready when transmitter idle (inverse of busy).

anchors.name: tx_data
anchors.why: Parallel byte to transmit, latched into the shift register.

anchors.name: tx_o
anchors.why: Serial line output: start low, data LSB, stop/idle high.

anchors.name: busy_o
anchors.why: Level busy indication while FSM not in rest phase.

groups.name: tx_controller
groups.description: One-hot phase FSM sequencing start, data and stop bits; idle decode drives busy/ready.

groups.name: baud_pacer
groups.description: Sub-instance divides clock into baud strobes, parked while idle.

groups.name: tx_serializer
groups.description: Shift register and bit counter serialize the byte onto tx_o.
